page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: tofis his Regnis & dura Hyeme jactatis utque tuâ demum Prudentiâ, Iustitia, Pietate restau-res, quæ stultitia quorundam & nequitia ita pene pessum dederunt ut nil integrum in Ec-clesia vel Statu reliquerint, nil Coronæ, Proceribus, Clero, Communitati, nil quod ad Leges, Libertates, Fortunas attinet, quod ad Ordinem, Honorem, Conscientiam & Vi-tam.

Sin vero Me penitus extinxerint, (haud enim scio an huc quoque processura sit ho-stium malitia & furor, & ex dictis quorundam & factis non obscura suspicio) quamvis illud non dubitandum, exclamaturum meum sanguinem ad Cœlos usque ob vindictam, Deum tamen obtestor, ne iram suam velit in illam maximam partem effundere, qui fraude & artificio & simulata Ducum Sancti-tate decepti: quos interno prius horrore cruciatos manet atrox aliquando supplici-cium.
Cæteris in Me optimè affectis, nihil sit (Deum precor) quod Me extinctum desiderent, ita valde voveo & spero, ut Virtutes Tuæ conspectæ in fœlicitatem omnibus sufficiant.

Eos vero quos perperam in Me admissorum poenitentia subierit, (ut jam lubens condono verbo Christiani Regis) ita in posterum non dubito quin sis vere fideles habiturus, amoremque & obsequium Mihi debitum promptos Tibi cum fœnore rependere.

page.notes: Show-through and stray marks along the left edge are not printed text and are left out. The catchword "num" is read at the lower right. Small uncertainties: the line "quod ad" may be set as "quod*ad" in the scan, and "rependere" may read "reppendere". Both are transcribed as the more likely reading.
